article.story: Wisconsin (6-4) at Purdue (3-7), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Wisconsin by 5.5. Against the spread: Wisconsin 5-5, Purdue 3-6-1. How to watch: NBC Key stats Wisconsin Offense Overall: 311 yards per game (126th in FBS) Passing: 177.9 yards per game (119th) Rushing: 133.1 yards per game (100th) Scoring: 24.1 points per game (97th) Wisconsin Defense Overall: 286.8 yards per game (14th in FBS) Passing: 185.1 yards per game (25th) Rushing: 101.7 yards per game (18th) Scoring: 17.1 points per game (14th) Purdue Offense Overall: 376.7 yards per game (72nd in FBS) Passing: 260.7 yards per game (27th) Rushing: 116 yards per game (120th) Scoring: 27.2 points per game (76th) Purdue Defense Overall: 417.3 yards per game (123rd in FBS) Passing: 239 yards per game (112th) Rushing: 178.3 yards per game (109th) Scoring: 31.9 points per game (122nd) Purdue is 135th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 50% of the time. Wisconsin ranks 75th on offense, converting on 39.2% of third downs. Purdue is 126th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 91.9% of trips. Wisconsin's red zone offense ranks 14th, scoring on 93.1% of red zone opportunities. Wisconsin is 130th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:20, compared to Purdue's 59th-ranked average of 30:32. Team leaders Wisconsin Passing: Colton Joseph, 1,368 yards, 11 TDs, 5 INTs, 56.1 completion percentage Rushing: Abu Sama III, 373 yards on 68 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Tyrell Henry, 434 yards on 36 catches, 1 TD Purdue Passing: Ryan Browne, 2,418 yards, 12 TDs, 6 INTs, 62.1 completion percentage Rushing: Fame Ijeboi, 684 yards on 175 carries, 10 TDs Receiving: Asaad Waseem, 802 yards on 49 catches, 1 TD Last game Wisconsin fell 24-21 to Maryland on Nov. 14. Ryan Hopkins threw for 77 yards on 11-of-22 attempts (50.0%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Darrion Dupree had 57 rushing yards on 14 carries and two touchdowns, adding four receptions for 21 yards. Jaylon Domingeaux had two receptions for 28 yards. Purdue lost 28-7 to Iowa on Nov. 14. Browne led Purdue with 158 yards on 14-of-23 passing (60.9%) for one touchdown and one interception. Ijeboi had 64 rushing yards on 15 carries, adding three receptions for 27 yards. Waseem had six receptions for 93 yards. Next game Wisconsin hosts Minnesota on Nov. 27. Purdue plays at No. 6 Indiana on Nov. 28.
